GET /health/ready.description: Readiness probe: checks the database. Exposes no data.

POST /api/v1/auth/login/.description: Credentials are the authentication itself. Throttled by IP and by account.

POST /api/v1/auth/refresh/.description: Authenticated by the refresh token in the body, which the service verifies.

PATCH /api/v1/auth/me/.description: Own profile: full_name, phone, avatar_url only.

POST /api/v1/auth/password/.description: Own password; needs the current one.

GET /api/v1/modules/.description: Every session builds its menu from this list.

GET /api/v1/permissions/.description: Also read by the users admin screen.

GET /api/v1/roles/.description: Also read by the users admin screen.

GET /api/v1/catalog-items/.description: Reference data read by every form (a pilot fills airports and units).

GET /api/v1/catalog-items/{id}/.description: Reference data read by every form.

GET /api/v1/audit/export/.description: CSV of the trail with the listing filters; leaves an export event.

GET /api/v1/tickets/.description: Rows are scoped in the repository to the types the caller may view.

GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}/.description: Scoped get: a ticket of a type the caller cannot view is a 404.

POST /api/v1/tickets/.description: Per-type permission checked in the service against the body type.

PATCH /api/v1/tickets/{id}/.description: Per-type permission checked in the service against the ticket type.

GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}/history/.description: Timeline of a ticket the caller can view.

POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/decisions/.description: The step must belong to the caller role unless tickets.decide_any; a signing step belongs to its role alone and needs tickets.sign or tickets.edit.

POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/authorize/.description: Management approval of a flagged expense.

GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}/extractions/.description: Readings of receipts of a viewable ticket.

POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/extractions/.description: Propose a reading as a person; the machine reader uses the service.

POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/extractions/{e.description: Review gate enforced in the service.

GET /api/v1/ticket-types/.description: Anyone who works tickets needs the form; rows are scoped per type.

GET /api/v1/rules/.description: Business rules are part of a type definition.

POST /api/v1/rules/.description: Business rules are part of a type definition.

GET /api/v1/rules/{id}/.description: Business rules are part of a type definition.

PATCH /api/v1/rules/{id}/.description: Business rules are part of a type definition.

DELETE /api/v1/rules/{id}/.description: Business rules are part of a type definition.

GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}/attachments/.description: Files of a ticket the caller can view (scoped get).

POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/attachments/.description: Multipart upload; per-type edit permission, content and size validated in the service.

GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}/attachments/{fi.description: Signed link to the original; a file of another ticket is a 404.

POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/attachments/{f.description: Review gate of the reading of one file, enforced in the service.

DELETE /api/v1/tickets/{id}/attachments/.description: Detach a file while the ticket is open.

POST /api/v1/attachments/extract/.description: Reads a receipt before the record exists; the type is checked in the service.

GET /api/v1/attachments/pending/.description: Validation queue, scoped in the query to viewable tickets.

GET /api/v1/notifications/.description: Only the notices addressed to the caller role or user, filtered in the query.

PATCH /api/v1/notifications/{id}/.description: Marks the caller own read state; a foreign notice is a 404.

POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all/.description: Marks every notice addressed to the caller as read.

GET /api/v1/tickets/totals/.description: Totals over the rows the caller may view (same scoped base query as the listing).

GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}/closing/.description: Closing summary of an operation the caller can view; any other id is a 404.

GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}/passengers/.description: Manifest of an operation the caller can view.

PUT /api/v1/tickets/{id}/passengers/.description: Replaces the manifest; per-type edit permission is checked in the service.

GET /api/v1/passengers/search/.description: Scope is applied in the query by the types the caller may view; none readable is a 404.

GET /api/v1/reconciliation/.description: Report of a month over the tickets the caller may view.

POST /api/v1/reconciliation/acknowledgem.description: Justify a difference of an open period.

POST /api/v1/reconciliation/close/.description: Close a period; needs every difference justified. Never reopened.

POST /api/v1/reconciliation/export/.description: Leaves the record of an export built by the client.

GET /api/v1/reconciliation/export/.description: CSV of the month, formula-injection safe.
